items.title: How Upstash Redis Search Works? | Upstash Blog

items.summary: Leveraging Server-Sent Events (SSE) to stream LLM responses in Next.js with LangChain and OpenAI's language models. Caching streaming responses with Upstash.

items.title: Redis vs Valkey: Features, Performance & Pricing in 2026 | Upstash Blog
items.summary: Valkey is a fork of Redis (7.2) under the Linux Foundation, offering ~90% command compatibility and a near-drop-in replacement. It prioritizes engine performance over built-in modules.
